profile.description: Update your name and email address
profile.name: Name
profile.resendLink: Click here to re-send the verification email.
profile.verificationSent: A new verification link has been sent to your email address.

profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.description: Group people, then share budgets and ledgers within a profile
profiles.inviteNote: The invite link expires after 48 hours and only works for this email address.
profiles.deleteNote: Deletes this profile. Blocked while it still has budgets or ledgers.
profiles.createDescription: A profile groups people — budgets and ledgers are shared within it.
profiles.deleteConfirmDescription: “{name}” will be permanently deleted. This is blocked while the profile still has budgets or ledgers.
profiles.removeConfirmDescription: {name} loses access to the profile's budgets and ledgers. Resources they own in the profile transfer to you.
profiles.leaveConfirmDescription: You will lose access to “{name}”. Resources you own in the profile transfer to the profile owner.
profiles.transferConfirmDescription: {member} becomes the owner of “{profile}”. You become a collaborator.
profiles.ownershipTransferredToast: Ownership transferred. You are now a collaborator.
profiles.inviteCreatedToast: Invite created — copy the link to share it.

security.title: Security settings
security.passwordDescription: Ensure your account is using a long, random password to stay secure

deleteUser.title: Delete account
deleteUser.description: Delete your account and all of its resources
deleteUser.warningDetail: Please proceed with caution, this cannot be undone.
deleteUser.confirmTitle: Are you sure you want to delete your account?
deleteUser.confirmDescription: Once your account is deleted, all of its resources and data will also be permanently deleted. Please enter your password to confirm you would like to permanently delete your account.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.disabledInfo: When you enable two-factor authentication, you will be prompted for a secure pin during login. This pin can be retrieved from a TOTP-supported application on your phone.
twoFactor.enabledInfo: You will be prompted for a secure, random pin during login, which you can retrieve from the TOTP-supported application on your phone.

twoFactorSetup.title: Enable two-factor authentication
twoFactorSetup.description: To finish enabling two-factor authentication, scan the QR code or enter the setup key in your authenticator app
twoFactorSetup.enabledDescription: Two-factor authentication is now enabled. Scan the QR code or enter the setup key in your authenticator app.
twoFactorSetup.verifyDescription: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app

twoFactorRecovery.title: 2FA recovery codes
twoFactorRecovery.description: Recovery codes let you regain access if you lose your 2FA device. Store them in a secure password manager.

passkeys.removeDescription: Are you sure you want to remove the "{name}" passkey? You will no longer be able to use it to sign in.
passkeys.notSupported: Passkeys are not supported in this browser.
passkeys.name: Passkey name
passkeys.nameHelp: A name helps you identify this passkey later.
